records.family: Hip implant contact and cement fixation
records.authors: Xijin Hua and Zhongmin Jin, University of Leeds
limitations: Only 40 mm cup, 45 degree references match supplied component CAD; other CSV rows are not CAD-paired here.
Pelvis and cement are valid IGES surfaces, not closed solids; cups are solids.
No separate native femoral-head CAD verified; head geometry remains in solver deck.
Supplied input deck represents one configuration; mapping of all four wear states to an executable setup remains to audit.
No certified replay tolerance or original dimensioned drawing verified.

records.family: Aircraft wing structural vibration / aeroelastic modal basis
records.authors: HIRENASD / Aeroelastic Prediction Workshop contributors, NASA DASHlink distribution
records.license: Public NASA download; dataset-specific redistribution license not stated on inspected pages.
records.reference_type: Published interpolated structural mode-shape fields on Centaur grid; not stress or forced response
limitations: IGES surface CAD in mm; published field coordinates in m. Bounds agree after 1e-3 conversion.
Structural BDF coordinate systems differ; original coordinate-system PDF included. Explicit frame correspondence remains to audit.
Modal amplitude/sign and interpolation conventions must be resolved before scoring; normalization-invariant comparison needed.
Frequency reference file not downloaded; resource 400 reports private access. Do not claim frequency ground truth from this package.
Not a complete coupled aerodynamic FEM solution; no verified dimensioned drawing.

records.authors: Daniele Botto and Matteo Glorioso, Politecnico di Torino
records.reference_type: Published reduced FE mass/stiffness matrices and connectivity, not solved response fields
limitations: Experimental decay/frequency/loss-factor arrays are not FEM ground truth and were not downloaded.
No full FE solver deck verified; original FE operators can be used for operator/reduction evaluation, not direct full-stress reference scoring.
No stress/displacement result fields supplied in downloaded FE reduced-model file.
No certified response tolerance or verified dimensioned drawing.
Two MAT download entries share identical bytes; only one original copy packaged.

records.authors: Marco Desiderio et al., TU Delft
records.reference_type: Published numerical FEM acceleration / dynamic-response-index plots; no machine-readable response arrays verified
limitations: STEP CAD consists of shell surfaces, appropriate for source shell models; not volumetric solid CAD.
Plots also contain experimental curves; FEM and experiment must be separated during digitization.
No CSV, ODB, or full-field/time-history output in collected subset. Numerical auto-scoring needs reviewed digitization and uncertainty.
Only 4/5/6-frame no-friction/no-damage decks selected; source variant mapping discrepancy avoided.
Published source CAD/real comparison image included; no verified dimensioned drawing.

records.family: Wire-arc additive manufacturing: transient thermal history and distortion
records.authors: Felix Vidal, Aurora Lopez, Paul Rosero, Martin Martinez, Andre Oeckerath and Abdallah Fawzy; AIMEN / Fraunhofer SCAI
records.reference_type: Published FEM temperature histories and thermomechanical nodal fields in VMAP/HDF5
subtasks: Transient thermal analysis, M1 ER70S6, 30 s dwell
Thermomechanical distortion, M1 ER70S6, 30 s dwell
limitations: One nominal wall-plus-baseplate STEP; thermal and distortion are two subtask types, not separate CAD designs.
M1 thermal extents agree with nominal STEP after axis permutation within 0.16 mm; exact mesh/CAD registration still pending.
M2 thermal height differs from nominal STEP by about 7.4 mm; retained as a held result variant, not counted as an exact CAD/FEM pair.
No executable original solver input deck verified in this collected subset. Manufacturing procedure and material PDFs supplied.
Thermal T_E fields are element-associated, not nodal temperatures.
Distortion file supplies DISP, NDTEMP, STRESS, TOSTRAIN, MESTRAIN, FORC, PE. Preserve raw values; stress/displacement unit and component-order review pending.

VMAP unit system declares SI but variable unit tags are -1. Distortion coordinates match CAD in mm, contradicting the declared metres; preserve raw values and do not certify displacement/stress units.
Source finite-element time steps are not additional benchmark cases.
No verified dimensioned engineering drawing; CAD inspection view only.
No certified scoring tolerance or independent replay.
